voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Bloomfield Township, Michigan. July thirtieth, nineteen seventy-five. Jimmy Hoffa, former president of the Teamsters, drove to the Machus Red Fox restaurant for a two o'clock meeting.
Around two-fifteen, he called his wife from a pay phone. No one had shown up. He said he'd be home by four, to grill steaks.
He never came home. His car was found in the parking lot.
Searches in Michigan and New Jersey found nothing. His body has never been found.
No one has ever been charged. The F B I says the case is still open.
